description: Inside a drive, when it must reach the person, write them a brief they can act on: what we understood, what we built, and where the gaps are — a few themed gaps, each with its context and our proposed answer — plus the knowledge pages waiting for approval and a pointer to the prototype notes. The person confirms or corrects in one reply; never a questionnaire. The drive shows the brief and records the reply. The last of the drive's three knowledge member plays (Shared Drive Run, R5b); never writes the product model.
